fact: The government says online company creation is effective on monentreprise.bj through APIEx, with 59 firms created online on 3 March 2020.
APIEx's guide says companies are registered in the RCCM entirely online through www.monentreprise.bj, with QR-coded electronic certificates issued in three working hours.
APIEx's guide lists among the certificates the platform issues the RCCM extract, the IFU tax identifier attestation and the CNSS employer number notification.
